items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: And, I always remember I was standing in there -- in the studio -- and Basie comes through with Teddy Reig.

ctx.x: They recorded that -- well, you recorded that. And, I always remember I was standing in there -- in the studio -- and Basie comes through with Teddy Reig. And, Teddy had evidently been saying it was old fashioned, or something like that, you know. And, Basie was saying -- 'well, look at it as a kind of satire'. (laugh).
